````
"""VC Intelligence Platform — M04D: user-facing navigation and developer diagnostics.
Existing FastAPI endpoints and persisted project/document data remain unchanged.
"""
import json
import os
import uuid
import urllib.error
import urllib.request

import streamlit as st

API_BASE = os.getenv('VC_API_BASE', 'http://127.0.0.1:8000').rstrip('/')
st.set_page_config(page_title='VC Intelligence Platform', page_icon='📊', layout='wide')


def api_request(path, method='GET', payload=None):
    data = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8') if payload is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(API_BASE + path, data=data, method=method,
                                 headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as response:
        return json.loads(response.read().decode('utf-8'))


def upload_bp(project_id, uploaded):
    boundary = 'vc' + uuid.uuid4().hex
    # Filename is only metadata; backend is responsible for sanitizing and storage.
    filename = uploaded.name.replace('"', '_').replace('\\', '_').replace('/', '_')
    body = (f'--{boundary}\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="{filename}"\r\n'
            'Content-Type: application/octet-stream\r\n\r\n').encode('utf-8') + uploaded.getvalue() + f'\r\n--{boundary}--\r\n'.encode('utf-8')
    req = urllib.request.Request(f'{API_BASE}/api/projects/{project_id}/documents', data=body, method='POST',
                                 headers={'Content-Type': f'multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as resp:
        return json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))


def error_text(exc):
    if isinstance(exc, urllib.error.HTTPError):
        return f'HTTP {exc.code}: ' + exc.read().decode('utf-8', errors='replace')[:500]
    return str(exc)


def project_label(p):
    return f"{p['name']} · #{p['id']}"


def list_docs(project_id):
    return api_request(f'/api/projects/{project_id}/documents')


def display_documents(docs):
    if not docs:
        st.info('该项目还没有上传 BP。')
        return
    for d in docs:
        status = d['status']
        with st.container(border=True):
            a, b = st.columns([4, 1])
            with a:
                st.markdown(f"**📄 {d['filename']}**")
                st.caption(f"{d['size_bytes'] / 1024 / 1024:.2f} MB · {d['segments']} 个原文片段 · 文件 #{d['id']}")
            with b:
                if status == 'processed':
                    st.success('解析完成', icon='✅')
                elif status == 'empty':
                    st.warning('未提取到文字')
                else:
                    st.error('解析失败')
            if d.get('warning'):
                st.warning('解析提示：' + d['warning'])
    st.caption('材料中的陈述尚未经过外部独立核验；图片、扫描文字和复杂图表可能无法完整提取。')


def project_selector(projects, key):
    if not projects:
        st.info('请先到「项目总览」创建一个投资项目。')
        return None
    ids = {p['id']: p for p in projects}
    chosen = st.selectbox('当前投资项目', options=list(ids), format_func=lambda x: project_label(ids[x]), key=key)
    return ids[chosen]


def dashboard(projects):
    st.header('项目总览')
    st.caption('集中管理投资项目与 BP 文件。')
    c1, c2 = st.columns(2)
    c1.metric('已创建项目', len(projects))
    c2.metric('分析流程', 'Mock 演示', help='支持模拟任务和报告保存，尚未执行真实 AI 分析')
    with st.expander('➕ 创建投资项目', expanded=not bool(projects)):
        with st.form('new_project', clear_on_submit=True):
            name = st.text_input('项目名称', placeholder='例如：示例 AI 创业公司')
            description = st.text_area('备注（可选）', height=80)
            submitted = st.form_submit_button('创建项目', type='primary')
            if submitted:
                if not name.strip():
                    st.warning('请填写项目名称。')
                else:
                    try:
                        api_request('/api/projects', 'POST', {'name': name, 'description': description})
                        st.success('项目创建成功。')
                        st.rerun()
                    except Exception as exc:
                        st.error('创建失败：' + error_text(exc))
    if projects:
        st.subheader('全部项目')
        st.dataframe([{'编号': p['id'], '项目名称': p['name'], '备注': p['description'], '创建时间': p['created_at']}
                      for p in projects], hide_index=True, use_container_width=True)
        st.info('选择左侧「项目工作台」，可为具体项目上传和管理 BP。')


REVIEW_LABELS = {'pending': '待人工审核', 'confirmed': '已人工审核', 'rejected': '已驳回'}


def project_overview(project_id):
    st.subheader('投资项目速览')
    try:
        overview = api_request(f'/api/projects/{project_id}/vc-overview')
    except Exception as exc:
        st.error('读取速览失败：' + error_text(exc))
        st.info('请确认已安装 M04A/M04B 后端，并停止旧服务后重新启动。')
        return
    summary = overview['summary']
    a, b = st.columns(2)
    a.metric('已有记录的字段', summary['with_candidates'])
    b.metric('档案字段总数', summary['catalog_fields'])
    st.caption('字段覆盖数量仅表示记录情况，不是投资评分，也不表示已核验。')
    st.info('尚未启用真实 AI 提取。可直接进入「分析任务」测试流程，无需先人工录入；如需校正，可使用「事实维护」。')
    for section in overview['sections']:
        with st.container(border=True):
            st.markdown('**' + section['title'] + '**')
            populated = [f for f in section['fields'] if f['state'] != 'missing']
            if not populated:
                st.caption('尚无相关记录')
            for field in populated:
                state = field['state']
                label = '存在不同口径，需复核' if state == 'potential_conflict' else ('已人工审核' if state == 'source_claim_reviewed' else '待人工审核')
                st.text(f"{field['label']}：{field['value']}")
                st.caption(f'{label} · 企业自述 · 未经外部核验')
                if field['has_conflict']:
                    st.warning('此字段有多条不同的已审核记录，当前只显示其中一条。请在「事实维护」查看全部记录并核对时间、币种与口径。')
                evidence = field.get('evidence')
                if evidence:
                    with st.expander('查看来源 · ' + field['label']):
                        st.text(evidence['document_name'] + ' · ' + evidence['location'])
                        st.text(evidence['quote'])
            missing = [f['label'] for f in section['fields'] if f['state'] == 'missing']
            if missing:
                st.caption('尚未录入：' + '、'.join(missing))
    st.caption(overview['notice'])


def fact_maintenance(project_id, docs):
    st.subheader('事实维护')
    st.caption('供资料录入与校正使用。人工审核表示引文与录入经过检查，不表示企业陈述真实。')
    try:
        fields = api_request('/api/extraction/fields')['fields']
        facts = api_request(f'/api/projects/{project_id}/facts')
    except Exception as exc:
        st.error('读取事实维护数据失败：' + error_text(exc))
        return
    with st.expander('新增有原文支持的记录', expanded=False):
        available = {d['id']: d for d in docs if d['segments'] > 0}
        if not available:
            st.info('请先在「项目文件」上传并解析资料。')
        else:
            docid = st.selectbox('来源文件', list(available), format_func=lambda i: available[i]['filename'], key=f'fact_doc_{project_id}')
            batches = max(1, (available[docid]['segments'] + 29) // 30)
            batch = st.number_input('原文批次（每批 30 条）', min_value=1, max_value=batches, value=1, key=f'fact_batch_{project_id}_{docid}')
            try:
                segments = api_request(f'/api/documents/{docid}/segments?offset={(batch-1)*30}&limit=30')['items']
            except Exception as exc:
                st.error('读取来源失败：' + error_text(exc))
                segments = []
            if segments:
                lookup = {x['id']: x for x in segments}
                sid = st.selectbox('来源片段', list(lookup), format_func=lambda i: f"{lookup[i]['location']} · #{i}", key=f'fact_segment_{project_id}_{docid}_{batch}')
                st.text(lookup[sid]['content'])
                with st.form(f'new_fact_{project_id}_{docid}_{sid}', clear_on_submit=True):
                    field = st.selectbox('档案字段', list(fields), format_func=lambda k: fields[k])
                    value = st.text_area('字段值', max_chars=3000)
                    quote = st.text_area('原文引文（从上方逐字复制）', max_chars=4000)
                    submit = st.form_submit_button('保存为待审核记录', type='primary')
                if submit:
                    if not value.strip() or not quote.strip():
                        st.warning('请填写字段值和原文引文。')
                    elif quote.strip() not in lookup[sid]['content']:
                        st.warning('引文必须逐字存在于所选来源片段中。')
                    else:
                        try:
                            api_request(f'/api/projects/{project_id}/facts', 'POST', {'segment_id': sid, 'field_key': field, 'value_text': value.strip(), 'evidence_quote': quote.strip()})
                            st.session_state['fact_flash'] = '记录已保存，状态为待人工审核。'
                            st.rerun()
                        except Exception as exc:
                            st.error('保存失败：' + error_text(exc))
    if 'fact_flash' in st.session_state:
        st.success(st.session_state.pop('fact_flash'))
    st.markdown('**已有记录**')
    state_filter = st.selectbox('审核状态筛选', ['all', 'pending', 'confirmed', 'rejected'], format_func=lambda x: '全部' if x == 'all' else REVIEW_LABELS[x], key=f'fact_filter_{project_id}')
    visible = [f for f in facts if state_filter == 'all' or f['review_status'] == state_filter]
    if not visible:
        st.info('当前没有符合条件的记录。')
    for fact in visible:
        with st.expander(f"#{fact['id']} · {fact['field_label']} · {REVIEW_LABELS.get(fact['review_status'], fact['review_status'])}"):
            st.text(fact['value_text'])
            document_name = next((d['filename'] for d in docs if d['id'] == fact['document_id']), f"文件 #{fact['document_id']}")
            st.caption(document_name + ' · ' + fact['location'])
            st.text(fact['evidence_quote'])
            st.caption('引文存在只证明它来自材料；请同时核对字段值是否受到引文支持。')
            with st.form(f"review_fact_{fact['id']}"):
                states = list(REVIEW_LABELS)
                state = st.selectbox('设置审核状态', states, index=states.index(fact['review_status']), format_func=lambda x: REVIEW_LABELS[x])
                note = st.text_area('审核备注', value=fact['reviewer_note'], max_chars=1000)
                reviewed = st.form_submit_button('保存审核状态')
            if reviewed:
                try:
                    api_request(f"/api/facts/{fact['id']}/review", 'PATCH', {'review_status': state, 'reviewer_note': note})
                    st.session_state['fact_flash'] = '审核状态已更新。'
                    st.rerun()
                except Exception as exc:
                    st.error('审核保存失败：' + error_text(exc))


def workspace(projects):
    st.header('项目工作台')
    project = project_selector(projects, 'workspace_project')
    if project is None:
        return
    st.caption('管理项目资料与结构化档案；所有 BP 陈述均未经外部独立核验。')
    section = st.radio('工作台视图', ['项目速览', '项目文件', '分析任务', '事实维护'], horizontal=True, key='workspace_view')
    if section == '项目速览':
        project_overview(project['id'])
        return
    if section == '分析任务':
        analysis_panel(project, allow_launch=True)
        return
    try:
        docs = list_docs(project['id'])
    except Exception as exc:
        st.error('无法读取项目文件：' + error_text(exc))
        return
    if section == '事实维护':
        fact_maintenance(project['id'], docs)
        return
    st.subheader('项目文件')
    display_documents(docs)
    st.subheader('上传新资料')
    uploaded = st.file_uploader('选择 PDF / PPTX / DOCX / XLSX（单文件最大 25 MB）',
                                type=['pdf', 'pptx', 'docx', 'xlsx'], key=f"bp_{project['id']}")
    if uploaded is not None:
        st.caption(f'待上传：{uploaded.name} · {uploaded.size / 1024 / 1024:.2f} MB')
        if st.button('上传并解析', type='primary', disabled=uploaded.size > 25 * 1024 * 1024):
            try:
                with st.spinner('正在本地保存并解析文件...'):
                    result = upload_bp(project['id'], uploaded)
                if result['status'] == 'processed':
                    st.success(f"上传成功，已提取 {result['segments']} 个原文片段。")
                else:
                    st.warning(f"已保存文件，解析状态：{result['status']}。{result.get('warning') or ''}")
                st.rerun()
            except Exception as exc:
                st.error('上传失败：' + error_text(exc))
    st.divider()
    st.subheader('投资分析')
    st.info('资料解析后，切换上方「分析任务」可发起 Mock 流程演示。无需先人工录入或审核。')


RUN_LABELS = {'queued': '等待执行', 'running': '正在执行', 'completed': '已完成', 'failed': '未完成'}


def show_report(report):
    st.subheader(report['title'])
    st.warning(report['notice'])
    a, b, c = st.columns(3)
    a.metric('关联资料', len(report['materials']))
    b.metric('真实 AI 提取', '未执行')
    c.metric('外部模型调用', report['external_calls'])
    st.caption('项目吸引力、投资风险、证据完备度均未评分。以下内容是资料快照、已有记录和规则模板。')
    if report['input_scope']['context_limited']:
        st.warning('模拟输入包含部分片段；尚未检查整份材料。')
    st.markdown('**项目要素 · 已有记录**')
    for section in report['sections']:
        with st.container(border=True):
            st.markdown('**' + section['title'] + '**')
            recorded = [f for f in section['fields'] if f['records']]
            if not recorded:
                st.caption('暂无结构化记录，尚未执行真实 AI 提取。')
            for field in recorded:
                for record in field['records']:
                    st.text(field['label'] + '：' + record['value'])
                    st.caption(REVIEW_LABELS.get(record['review_status'], record['review_status']) + ' · 企业自述 · 未经外部核验')
                    with st.expander('查看报告证据 · ' + field['label'] + f" · #{record['assertion_id']}"):
                        evidence = record['evidence']
                        st.text(evidence['document_name'] + ' · ' + evidence['location'])
                        st.text(evidence['quote'])
                        if not record['quote_matches']:
                            st.error('当前来源不再包含该引文，需复核。')
    st.markdown('**资料检查 · 固定规则**')
    gaps = [f for f in report['findings'] if f['kind'] == 'record_gap']
    issues = [f for f in report['findings'] if f['kind'] != 'record_gap']
    st.caption(f'尚无结构化记录的字段：{len(gaps)} 项。尚未执行 AI 提取，不能据此认定 BP 缺少信息。')
    if not issues:
        st.info('未触发当前固定检查规则；这不表示项目无风险，也不表示已通过 AI 审核。')
    for issue in issues:
        st.warning(issue['message'])
        if issue['evidence']:
            with st.expander('检查依据 · ' + issue['message']):
                for evidence in issue['evidence']:
                    st.text(evidence['document_name'] + ' · ' + evidence['location'])
                    st.text(evidence['quote'])
    with st.expander(f"追问清单 · {len(report['questions'])} 条固定模板（非 AI 建议）"):
        if report['questions']:
            st.dataframe([{'序号': i, '待确认问题': q['question']} for i, q in enumerate(report['questions'], 1)], hide_index=True, use_container_width=True)
        else:
            st.caption('未生成固定模板问题；不表示尽调已经完成。')
    with st.expander('关联材料与来源抽样'):
        for doc in report['materials']:
            st.text(doc['filename'])
            st.caption(f"片段数：{doc['segments']} · 解析状态：{doc['status']}")
        st.caption('下方最多三段原文摘录仅演示来源引用，不是 AI 提取或摘要。')
        names = {d['id']: d['filename'] for d in report['materials']}
        for source in report['source_preview']:
            st.text(names.get(source['document_id'], '原文件') + ' · ' + source['location'])
            st.text(source['content'])
    st.caption(report['snapshot_notice'])
    st.caption(f"流程版本：{report['pipeline_version']} · 模型：{report['model']} · 模板：{report['prompt_version']}")


def analysis_panel(project, allow_launch=False):
    project_id = project['id']
    st.caption('先跑通自动任务与报告，再接入真实模型测试能力。人工维护是可选校正入口。')
    st.warning('当前为 Mock 流程，不调用真实模型，不执行 AI 提取或语义审核。')
    try:
        runs = api_request(f'/api/projects/{project_id}/analysis-runs')
    except Exception as exc:
        st.error('读取任务失败：' + error_text(exc))
        st.info('请确认完整安装本次后端更新，并停止旧服务后重新启动。')
        return
    active = any(r['status'] in ('queued', 'running') for r in runs)
    if allow_launch:
        if st.button('运行模拟分析', type='primary', disabled=active, key=f'launch_analysis_{project_id}'):
            try:
                result = api_request(f'/api/projects/{project_id}/analysis-runs', 'POST', {'mode': 'mock'})
                st.session_state[f'report_run_{project_id}'] = result['id']
                st.rerun()
            except Exception as exc:
                st.error('任务未能创建：' + error_text(exc))
    if st.button('刷新任务状态', key=f'refresh_analysis_{project_id}'):
        st.rerun()
    if not runs:
        st.info('还没有分析任务。上传可解析的 BP 后，在「项目工作台 → 分析任务」发起模拟分析。')
        return
    lookup = {r['id']: r for r in runs}
    selection_key = f'report_run_{project_id}'
    if st.session_state.get(selection_key) not in lookup:
        st.session_state[selection_key] = next(iter(lookup))
    rid = st.selectbox('选择已保存的任务（最近100条）', list(lookup),
        format_func=lambda i: f"#{i} · {RUN_LABELS.get(lookup[i]['status'], lookup[i]['status'])} · Mock", key=selection_key)
    try:
        run = api_request(f'/api/analysis-runs/{rid}')
    except Exception as exc:
        st.error('读取任务详情失败：' + error_text(exc))
        return
    st.write('任务状态：' + RUN_LABELS.get(run['status'], run['status']))
    if run['status'] in ('queued', 'running'):
        st.info('任务正在后台执行，稍后点击「刷新任务状态」。')
    if run['status'] == 'failed':
        st.error(run['error'])
        st.caption('可以重新发起任务，原始资料与旧报告保留。')
    if run['steps']:
        with st.expander('查看执行步骤'):
            st.dataframe([{'步骤': step['title'], '状态': RUN_LABELS.get(step['status'], step['status'])} for step in run['steps']], hide_index=True, use_container_width=True)
    if run['status'] == 'completed' and run['report']:
        show_report(run['report'])
        st.download_button('下载演示报告 JSON', data=json.dumps(run, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
            file_name=f'project_{project_id}_mock_report_{rid}.json', mime='application/json', key=f'download_report_{rid}')


def reports():
    st.header('投资报告')
    project = project_selector(projects_cache, 'report_project')
    if project:
        analysis_panel(project)


def knowledge():
    st.header('知识库')
    st.info('历史 BP 检索、RAG 与投资案例管理将在后续版本上线。当前已上传文件仍保存在本地。')


def settings():
    st.header('系统设置')
    try:
        status = api_request('/api/model/status')
        st.markdown('**模型连接状态**')
        st.write('运行模式：', status.get('mode', '未知'))
        st.write('模型名称：', status.get('model', '未知'))
        if status.get('mode') == 'mock':
            st.info('当前为 Mock 模式，无外部 AI 调用费用。')
        else:
            st.warning('使用真实 API 时，需确认商业资料具有对外发送授权。')
    except Exception as exc:
        st.error('读取模型状态失败：' + error_text(exc))
    st.caption('API Key 请仅保存在后端本地 .env 中，不要粘贴到网页或聊天中。')
    st.divider()
    st.markdown('**开发者工具**')
    st.caption('下面的逐页原文和 Mock 测试仅供开发、排查和证据抽查。')
    if st.toggle('显示开发者调试面板', value=False, key='developer_mode'):
        st.subheader('Mock 智能体测试')
        with st.form('agent_demo'):
            question = st.text_area('测试问题', value='请说明投资分析中为什么要区分项目吸引力与证据完备度？', max_chars=3000)
            ask = st.form_submit_button('执行测试')
        if ask:
            try:
                result = api_request('/api/agents/demo', 'POST', {'question': question})
                st.write(result.get('answer', ''))
                st.caption(f"模型：{result.get('model', '未知')} · 耗时：{result.get('elapsed_ms', '-')} ms")
            except Exception as exc:
                st.error('测试失败：' + error_text(exc))
        st.divider()
        st.subheader('查看文档解析原文')
        project = project_selector(projects_cache, 'debug_project')
        if project:
            try:
                docs = list_docs(project['id'])
                if docs:
                    lookup = {d['id']: d for d in docs}
                    selected = st.selectbox('选择文件', list(lookup),
                                            format_func=lambda i: f"#{i} · {lookup[i]['filename']}", key='debug_document')
                    current = lookup[selected]
                    if current['segments']:
                        total_pages = max(1, (current['segments'] + 29) // 30)
                        page = st.number_input('片段批次（每批最多 30 条）', min_value=1, max_value=total_pages, value=1)
                        result = api_request(f'/api/documents/{selected}/segments?offset={(page-1)*30}&limit=30')
                        for part in result['items']:
                            with st.expander(part['location']):
                                st.text(part['content'])
                    else:
                        st.info('此文件没有可查看的原文片段。')
                else:
                    st.info('项目还没有文件。')
            except Exception as exc:
                st.error('读取原文失败：' + error_text(exc))


st.sidebar.title('VC Intelligence')
st.sidebar.caption('投资决策平台 · 本地开发版')
page = st.sidebar.radio('功能导航', ['项目总览', '项目工作台', '投资报告', '知识库', '系统设置'], key='nav_page')
st.sidebar.divider()
st.sidebar.caption('本地开发版 · 模拟分析流程')
st.title('VC Intelligence Platform')
try:
    health = api_request('/health')
    if health.get('status') != 'ok':
        st.warning('后端状态异常')
except Exception as exc:
    st.error('无法连接后端。请从 start_platform.bat 一键启动，并确认后端服务运行正常。')
    st.caption(error_text(exc))
    st.stop()
try:
    projects_cache = api_request('/api/projects')
except Exception as exc:
    st.error('无法读取项目：' + error_text(exc))
    st.stop()

if page == '项目总览':
    dashboard(projects_cache)
elif page == '项目工作台':
    workspace(projects_cache)
elif page == '投资报告':
    reports()
elif page == '知识库':
    knowledge()
else:
    settings()

async function api(path,options={}){const headers=options.body&&!(options.body instanceof FormData)?{'Content-Type':'application/json'}:{};const response=await fetch(path,{...options,headers:{...headers,...options.headers}});if(!response.ok){let data;try{data=await response.json()}catch{}throw Error(typeof data?.detail==='string'?data.detail:`请求失败（${response.status}），请检查输入或服务状态。`)}return response.json()}

document.querySelectorAll('[data-page]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>nav(b.dataset.page));window.addEventListener('hashchange',()=>{let p=location.hash.slice(1);if(['create','library','settings'].includes(p)&&p!==state.page)nav(p)});
async function loadModels(){state.models=await api('/api/v2/models');const oldChecked=new Set([...document.querySelectorAll('input[name=model]:checked')].map(x=>+x.value));const previousChat=$('chatModel').value;const enabled=state.models.filter(m=>m.enabled);$('modelChoices').innerHTML=enabled.length?enabled.map(m=>`<label><input type="checkbox" name="model" value="${m.id}" ${m.key_configured?'':'disabled'} ${m.key_configured&&(oldChecked.size?oldChecked.has(m.id):true)?'checked':''}> ${esc(m.name)} <small>${m.key_configured?esc(m.model):'待配置密钥'}</small></label>`).join(''):'<p>暂无启用模型，请先在模型设置中添加。</p>';$('chatModel').innerHTML=enabled.filter(m=>m.key_configured).map(m=>`<option value="${m.id}">${esc(m.name)}</option>`).join('');if([...$('chatModel').options].some(o=>o.value===previousChat))$('chatModel').value=previousChat;$('modelList').innerHTML=state.models.map(m=>`<div class="card row"><div><span class="pill">${m.enabled?'已启用':'已停用'}</span><h2>${esc(m.name)}</h2><small>${esc(m.model)} · ${m.api_kind==='responses'?'Responses':'Chat Completions'}</small><p>${esc(m.base_url)}</p><small>密钥：${m.key_configured?'已配置（不回显）':'待填写'} · 输出上限 ${m.max_output_tokens} tokens</small></div><div><button data-edit="${m.id}">编辑</button> <button data-test="${m.id}" ${m.key_configured?'':'disabled'}>测试连接</button> <button data-delete="${m.id}">删除</button></div></div>`).join('');$('modelList').querySelectorAll('[data-edit]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>editModel(+b.dataset.edit));$('modelList').querySelectorAll('[data-delete]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>action(b,async()=>{if(!confirm('删除此模型配置？历史报告和对话仍保留。'))return;await api('/api/v2/models/'+b.dataset.delete,{method:'DELETE'});if(state.editing===+b.dataset.delete)clearModel();await loadModels()}));$('modelList').querySelectorAll('[data-test]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>action(b,async()=>{toast('正在测试连接，会产生少量 API 用量…');let r=await api(`/api/v2/models/${b.dataset.test}/test`,{method:'POST'});toast(r.message)}))}

function editModel(id){const m=state.models.find(x=>x.id===id);state.editing=id;$('modelFormTitle').textContent='编辑 '+m.name;$('modelName').value=m.name;$('modelCode').value=m.model;$('modelUrl').value=m.base_url;$('apiKind').value=m.api_kind;$('maxTokens').value=m.max_output_tokens;$('modelEnabled').checked=m.enabled;$('apiKey').value='';$('clearKey').checked=false;$('modelFormTitle').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})}
$('cancelModel').onclick=clearModel;$('modelForm').onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();action(e.submitter,async()=>{const payload={name:$('modelName').value.trim(),model:$('modelCode').value.trim(),base_url:$('modelUrl').value.trim(),api_kind:$('apiKind').value,max_output_tokens:+$('maxTokens').value,enabled:$('modelEnabled').checked,clear_key:$('clearKey').checked};if($('apiKey').value.trim())payload.api_key=$('apiKey').value.trim();await api('/api/v2/models'+(state.editing?'/'+state.editing:''),json(state.editing?'PUT':'POST',payload));clearModel();await loadModels();toast('模型设置已保存。')})};

function selectedFile(file){if(!file)return;if(!/\.(pdf|pptx|docx|xlsx)$/i.test(file.name)||!file.size||file.size>25*1024*1024){toast('请选择非空的 PDF/PPTX/DOCX/XLSX，最大 25 MB。',true);return}state.file=file;state.importId=null;$('fileLabel').textContent=file.name+' · '+(file.size/1024/1024).toFixed(2)+' MB';$('selectedFile').classList.remove('hidden');$('uploadStatus').textContent='已选择文件，点击识别后自动创建项目。'}
$('file').onchange=e=>selectedFile(e.target.files[0]);$('drop').onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();$('file').click()}};$('drop').ondragover=e=>{e.preventDefault();$('drop').classList.add('drag')};$('drop').ondragleave=()=>$('drop').classList.remove('drag');$('drop').ondrop=e=>{e.preventDefault();$('drop').classList.remove('drag');selectedFile(e.dataTransfer.files[0])};
$('importButton').onclick=()=>action($('importButton'),async()=>{if(!state.file)return;const file=state.file;const digest=[...new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',await file.arrayBuffer()))].map(x=>x.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');const storageKey='vc-import:'+digest;state.importId=sessionStorage.getItem(storageKey)||crypto.randomUUID();sessionStorage.setItem(storageKey,state.importId);const form=new FormData();form.append('file',file);form.append('request_id',state.importId);$('uploadStatus').textContent='正在本地解析资料…';let result=await api('/api/v2/imports',{method:'POST',body:form});await loadProjects();await openProject(result.project.id);$('nameSource').textContent='名称来源：'+result.name_source;toast(result.document.status==='processed'?'资料已解析，可确认名称并生成报告。':result.document.warning,result.document.status!=='processed')});
async function openProject(id){let p=state.projects.find(p=>p.id===id);if(!p){await loadProjects();p=state.projects.find(p=>p.id===id)}if(!p)throw Error('项目不存在');state.project=p;state.report=null;state.runRequest=null;state.chatRequest=null;state.sourceOffset=0;localStorage.setItem('vc-project',id);$('projectName').value=p.name;$('nameSource').textContent='名称可随时修改；历史报告保留生成时名称。';$('projectCard').classList.remove('hidden');$('uploadCard').classList.add('hidden');$('currentReports').innerHTML='';$('chatContext').textContent='当前项目：'+p.name;syncChatLabel();nav('create',false);await Promise.all([loadDocuments(),loadFacts(),loadJobs(),loadMessages()])}
$('resumeButton').onclick=()=>action($('resumeButton'),()=>openProject(+$('resumeProject').value));$('newProject').onclick=()=>{state.project=null;state.report=null;state.file=null;localStorage.removeItem('vc-project');$('file').value='';$('projectCard').classList.add('hidden');$('uploadCard').classList.remove('hidden');$('selectedFile').classList.add('hidden');$('uploadStatus').textContent='';$('jobs').innerHTML='';$('currentReports').innerHTML='';$('messages').innerHTML='';$('chatContext').textContent='请先上传资料或打开一个项目。';syncChatLabel()};
async function saveName(){if(!state.project)return;const name=$('projectName').value.trim();if(!name)throw Error('项目名称不能为空');state.project=await api(`/api/v2/projects/${state.project.id}`,json('PATCH',{name}));$('chatContext').textContent='当前项目：'+state.project.name;await loadProjects()}
$('renameForm').onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();action(e.submitter,async()=>{await saveName();toast('项目名称已保存。')})};
async function loadDocuments(){const pid=state.project?.id;if(!pid)return;let docs=await api(`/api/projects/${pid}/documents`);if(state.project?.id!==pid)return;$('documents').innerHTML=docs.map(d=>`<div class="file"><strong>${esc(d.filename)}</strong> <span class="pill ${d.status==='processed'?'':'failed'}">${({processed:'解析完成',empty:'无可提取文字',failed:'解析失败'})[d.status]||esc(d.status)}</span><p>${d.segments} 个片段 · ${(d.size_bytes/1024/1024).toFixed(2)} MB</p><small>${esc(d.warning)}</small></div>`).join('');$('runButton').disabled=!docs.some(d=>d.segments>0);$('factDocument').innerHTML=docs.filter(d=>d.segments).map(d=>`<option value="${d.id}">${esc(d.filename)}</option>`).join('');await loadSources()}
async function loadSources(){let did=$('factDocument').value;if(!did){state.sources=[];$('factSegment').innerHTML='';$('sourceText').textContent='暂无原文片段';return}let r=await api(`/api/documents/${did}/segments?offset=${state.sourceOffset}&limit=30`);if(did!==$('factDocument').value)return;state.sources=r.items;$('factSegment').innerHTML=r.items.map(x=>`<option value="${x.id}">${esc(x.location)} · #${x.id}</option>`).join('');$('sourcePage').textContent='第 '+(state.sourceOffset/30+1)+' 批';$('prevSources').disabled=!state.sourceOffset;$('nextSources').disabled=r.items.length<30;showSource()}
function showSource(){$('sourceText').textContent=state.sources.find(s=>s.id===+$('factSegment').value)?.content||''}$('factSegment').onchange=showSource;$('factDocument').onchange=()=>{state.sourceOffset=0;action(null,loadSources)};$('prevSources').onclick=()=>{state.sourceOffset=Math.max(0,state.sourceOffset-30);action(null,loadSources)};$('nextSources').onclick=()=>{state.sourceOffset+=30;action(null,loadSources)};
async function loadFacts(){const pid=state.project?.id;if(!pid)return;const [fields,facts]=await Promise.all([api('/api/extraction/fields'),api(`/api/projects/${pid}/facts`)]);if(state.project?.id!==pid)return;$('factField').innerHTML=Object.entries(fields.fields).map(([k,v])=>`<option value="${esc(k)}">${esc(v)}</option>`).join('');$('facts').innerHTML=facts.length?facts.map(f=>`<div class="file"><strong>${esc(f.field_label)}：${esc(f.value_text)}</strong><pre>${esc(f.evidence_quote)}</pre><small>${esc(f.location)} · 人工审核不等于真实性核验</small><select data-review="${f.id}">${[['pending','待审核'],['confirmed','已确认'],['rejected','已驳回']].map(([k,v])=>`<option value="${k}" ${k===f.review_status?'selected':''}>${v}</option>`).join('')}</select></div>`).join(''):'<p>暂无人工记录；不影响直接分析 BP。</p>';$('facts').querySelectorAll('[data-review]').forEach(el=>el.onchange=()=>action(el,async()=>{await api(`/api/facts/${el.dataset.review}/review`,json('PATCH',{review_status:el.value,reviewer_note:facts.find(f=>f.id===+el.dataset.review)?.reviewer_note||''}));toast('审核状态已更新。')}))}
$('factForm').onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();action(e.submitter,async()=>{if(!state.project||!$('factSegment').value)throw Error('请先选择可用原文');await api(`/api/projects/${state.project.id}/facts`,json('POST',{segment_id:+$('factSegment').value,field_key:$('factField').value,value_text:$('factValue').value,evidence_quote:$('factQuote').value}));$('factValue').value='';$('factQuote').value='';await loadFacts();toast('事实已保存。')})};
$('runButton').onclick=()=>action($('runButton'),async()=>{if(!state.project)return;const ids=[...document.querySelectorAll('input[name=model]:checked')].map(x=>+x.value);if(!ids.length)throw Error('请先在模型设置中填写密钥，再选择模型。');await saveName();const signature=state.project.id+':'+ids.join(',');if(state.runRequest?.signature!==signature)state.runRequest={signature,id:crypto.randomUUID()};await api(`/api/v2/projects/${state.project.id}/runs`,json('POST',{model_ids:ids,request_id:state.runRequest.id}));state.runRequest=null;toast('分析已提交，完成后自动出现在报告库。');await loadJobs()});
async function loadJobs(){const pid=state.project?.id;if(!pid)return;const jobs=await api(`/api/v2/projects/${pid}/runs`);if(state.project?.id!==pid)return;$('jobs').innerHTML=jobs.slice(0,10).map(j=>`<div class="card job row"><div><strong>${esc(j.model_name)}</strong> <span class="pill ${j.status}">${statusText[j.status]}</span><small> · ${esc(j.model)}</small>${j.error?`<p>${esc(j.error)}</p>`:''}</div>${j.status==='completed'?`<button data-job="${j.id}">查看报告</button>`:j.status==='failed'?`<button data-retry="${j.model_id}">单独重试</button>`:''}</div>`).join('');$('jobs').querySelectorAll('[data-job]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>action(b,()=>openReport(+b.dataset.job,false,'currentReports')));$('jobs').querySelectorAll('[data-retry]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>action(b,async()=>{await api(`/api/v2/projects/${pid}/runs`,json('POST',{model_ids:[+b.dataset.retry],request_id:crypto.randomUUID()}));await loadJobs()}));$('runButton').disabled=jobs.some(j=>['queued','running'].includes(j.status))||!$('factDocument').value}
function sourceHTML(sources,ids){return sources.filter(s=>ids.includes(s.id)).map(s=>`<details><summary>#${s.id} · ${esc(s.document_name||'资料')} · ${esc(s.location)}</summary><pre>${esc(s.content)}</pre></details>`).join('')}
function reportHTML(j){let r=j.result;return `<div class="card"><div class="row"><div><small>${esc(j.model_name)} · ${esc(j.model)}</small><h2>${esc(j.project_name)}</h2></div><span class="pill">已完成${j.legacy?' · Mock':''}</span></div><small>${esc(j.created_at)} · 报告快照 #${j.id}</small><div class="notice">${j.legacy?'历史模拟报告，未执行真实 AI 分析。':'AI 辅助研究，企业自述未经独立核验。引用说明原文来源，不代表模型解读已被证实。'}${j.context_limited?' 本次仅分析了部分材料文字。':''}</div><h3>研究摘要</h3><div class="report-body">${esc(r.summary)}</div>${(r.sections||[]).map(s=>`<section class="report-section"><h3>${esc(s.title)}</h3><div class="report-body">${esc(s.body)}</div>${sourceHTML(j.sources||[],s.source_ids||[])}</section>`).join('')}<h3>尽调追问</h3><ol>${(r.questions||[]).map(q=>`<li>${esc(q)}</li>`).join('')}</ol><details><summary>关联材料与用量</summary><p>${(j.documents||[]).map(d=>esc(d.filename)).join('、')}</p><pre>${esc(JSON.stringify(r.usage||{},null,2))}</pre></details><div class="row report-actions"><small>项目后续改名不会改写这份报告。</small><a class="pdf-link" href="/api/v2/reports/${j.id}/pdf${j.legacy?'?legacy=true':''}" download>下载报告 PDF</a></div></div>`}
async function openReport(id,legacy=false,target='reportDetail'){let j;if(legacy){let run=await api('/api/analysis-runs/'+id),r=run.report;j={...run,legacy:true,project_name:r.project?.name||'历史报告',model_name:'历史 Mock',model:'mock',sources:r.source_preview||[],documents:r.materials||[],result:{summary:r.notice,sections:(r.sections||[]).map(s=>({title:s.title,body:s.fields.flatMap(f=>f.records.map(v=>f.label+'：'+v.value)).join('\n')||'暂无记录',source_ids:[]})),questions:(r.questions||[]).map(q=>q.question)}}}else j=await api('/api/v2/jobs/'+id);let p=state.projects.find(p=>p.id===j.project_id);if(p){state.project=p;localStorage.setItem('vc-project',p.id)}state.report=legacy?null:j;$('chatContext').textContent='当前项目：'+(p?.name||j.project_name);if(j.model_id&&state.models.some(m=>m.id===j.model_id&&m.enabled&&m.key_configured))$('chatModel').value=j.model_id;syncChatLabel();$(target).innerHTML=reportHTML(j);await loadMessages();$(target).scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})}
async function loadReports(){state.reports=await api('/api/v2/reports');$('reportCount').textContent=state.reports.length||'';renderReports()}
function renderReports(){const q=$('search').value.trim().toLowerCase(),list=state.reports.filter(r=>[r.project_name,r.current_project_name,r.model_name].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(q));$('reportList').innerHTML=list.length?list.map(r=>`<div class="card row"><div><span class="pill">${r.legacy?'历史 Mock':'已完成'}</span><h2>${esc(r.project_name)}</h2><small>${esc(r.model_name)} · ${esc(r.created_at)}${r.current_project_name!==r.project_name?' · 当前项目名：'+esc(r.current_project_name):''}</small></div><button data-report="${r.id}" data-legacy="${r.legacy}">查看报告 →</button></div>`).join(''):'<div class="card"><h2>这里将保存你的研究成果</h2><p>创建分析并完成后，报告会自动出现在这里。</p></div>';$('reportList').querySelectorAll('[data-report]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>action(b,()=>openReport(+b.dataset.report,b.dataset.legacy==='true')))}$('search').oninput=renderReports;
function syncChatLabel(){$('chatReport').textContent=state.report?'基于报告 #'+state.report.id+' 的资料快照':'基于当前项目资料';$('clearReport').classList.toggle('hidden',!state.report)}$('clearReport').onclick=()=>{state.report=null;syncChatLabel()};$('toggleChat').onclick=()=>{$('chat').classList.toggle('hidden');if(!$('chat').classList.contains('hidden'))action(null,loadMessages)};$('closeChat').onclick=()=>$('chat').classList.add('hidden');
async function loadMessages(){const pid=state.project?.id;if(!pid){$('chatContext').textContent='请先上传资料或打开一个项目。';return}let messages=await api(`/api/v2/projects/${pid}/messages`);if(state.project?.id!==pid)return;const oldBottom=$('messages').scrollHeight-$('messages').scrollTop-$('messages').clientHeight<80;$('messages').innerHTML=messages.map(m=>`<div class="message"><div class="question">${esc(m.question)}</div><small>${esc(m.model_name)} · ${statusText[m.status]}${m.report_id?' · 报告 #'+m.report_id:''}</small><div class="answer">${esc(m.status==='completed'?m.result.answer:m.error||'正在等待模型回复…')}</div>${m.context_limited||m.history_limited?'<small>上下文已按长度限制截取。</small>':''}${sourceHTML(m.sources||[],m.result?.source_ids||[])}${m.status==='failed'?`<button data-message-retry="${m.id}">重试此问题</button>`:''}</div>`).join('');$('messages').querySelectorAll('[data-message-retry]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{let m=messages.find(x=>x.id===+b.dataset.messageRetry);$('question').value=m.question;$('chatModel').value=m.model_id;state.report=m.report_id?{id:m.report_id}:null;syncChatLabel();$('question').focus()});$('askButton').disabled=messages.some(m=>['queued','running'].includes(m.status));if(oldBottom)$('messages').scrollTop=$('messages').scrollHeight}
$('chatForm').onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();action(e.submitter,async()=>{if(!state.project)throw Error('请先上传资料或打开一个项目。');let model=+$('chatModel').value,question=$('question').value.trim();if(!model)throw Error('请先配置并启用模型 API 密钥。');if(!question)throw Error('请输入问题。');let signature=JSON.stringify([state.project.id,model,question,state.report?.id]);if(state.chatRequest?.signature!==signature)state.chatRequest={signature,id:crypto.randomUUID()};await api(`/api/v2/projects/${state.project.id}/messages`,json('POST',{model_id:model,question,report_id:state.report?.id||null,request_id:state.chatRequest.id}));state.chatRequest=null;$('question').value='';await loadMessages()})};
async function poll(){if(state.polling)return;state.polling=true;try{if(state.project){if(state.page==='create')await loadJobs();if(!$('chat').classList.contains('hidden'))await loadMessages()}if(state.page==='library')await loadReports()}catch(e){toast('服务暂时不可用：'+e.message,true)}finally{state.polling=false}}
async function init(){await Promise.all([loadModels(),loadProjects(),loadReports()]);clearModel();let pid=+localStorage.getItem('vc-project');if(state.projects.some(p=>p.id===pid))await openProject(pid);let page=location.hash.slice(1);if(['create','library','settings'].includes(page))nav(page);setInterval(poll,3000)}action(null,init);
````

## frontend/web/index.html

````
<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>VC Intelligence · 投资研究</title><link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css"><script src="app.js" defer></script></head><body>
<header><a class="brand" href="#create">VC <span>Intelligence</span></a><nav aria-label="主导航"><button data-page="create" class="active">创建分析</button><button data-page="library">报告库 <span id="reportCount"></span></button></nav><button data-page="settings" class="settings-nav">模型设置</button></header>
<main><div id="toast" role="status" class="hidden notice"></div>
<section id="create" class="page"><div class="eyebrow">NEW ANALYSIS</div><h1>从一份 BP，开始了解项目</h1><p class="subtitle">上传资料，确认项目名称，在这里完成分析与报告查看。</p><div class="steps"><span>01 上传 BP</span><span>02 确认名称与模型</span><span>03 查看报告</span></div>
<div id="uploadCard" class="card"><label id="drop" class="drop" tabindex="0" for="file"><span class="upload-icon">↥</span><h2>将 BP 拖到这里，或点击选择</h2><p>PDF、PPTX、DOCX、XLSX · 最大 25 MB</p><small>先在本机解析；仅在发起分析或追问时发送文字至所选 API</small></label><input id="file" type="file" accept=".pdf,.pptx,.docx,.xlsx" hidden><div id="selectedFile" class="row hidden"><p id="fileLabel"></p><button id="importButton" class="primary">识别 BP →</button></div><p id="uploadStatus" role="status"></p></div>
<div id="projectCard" class="card hidden"><div class="row"><h2>确认项目信息</h2><button id="newProject">＋ 新的分析</button></div><form id="renameForm"><label>项目名称<input id="projectName" maxlength="200" required></label><div class="row"><small id="nameSource"></small><button type="submit">保存名称</button></div></form><div id="documents"></div><h3>选择分析模型</h3><div id="modelChoices" class="choices"></div><div class="notice">AI 输出基于企业资料，未经独立核验。发起分析将调用所选模型 API，按服务商规则计费；每次最多选择 5 个模型。</div><div class="row action-row"><small>上限：60,000 字符输入 · 3 路同时调用</small><button id="runButton" class="primary">生成分析报告 →</button></div><details><summary>资料与事实记录</summary><div id="facts"></div><form id="factForm"><h3>补充有原文支持的事实</h3><label>原文文件<select id="factDocument"></select></label><div class="row"><button type="button" id="prevSources">上一批</button><small id="sourcePage"></small><button type="button" id="nextSources">下一批</button></div><label>原文片段<select id="factSegment"></select></label><pre id="sourceText"></pre><label>字段<select id="factField"></select></label><label>字段值<textarea id="factValue" maxlength="3000" required></textarea></label><label>逐字引文<textarea id="factQuote" maxlength="4000" required></textarea></label><button type="submit">保存待审核记录</button></form></details></div>
<div id="jobs"></div><div id="currentReports"></div><div class="card"><h2>继续已有项目</h2><p>已上传的资料、未完成任务和历史项目都会保留。</p><div class="row"><select id="resumeProject" aria-label="已有项目"></select><button id="resumeButton">打开项目 →</button></div></div></section>
<section id="library" class="page hidden"><div class="eyebrow">REPORT LIBRARY</div><h1>已完成报告</h1><p class="subtitle">每个模型独立成稿，每一份研究都保留来源。</p><input id="search" placeholder="搜索项目名称或模型…" aria-label="搜索报告"><div id="reportList"></div><div id="reportDetail"></div></section>
<section id="settings" class="page hidden"><div class="eyebrow">MODEL SETTINGS</div><h1>你的 AI 模型</h1><p class="subtitle">默认接入 ChatGPT，也可添加其他 OpenAI 兼容接口。</p><div class="notice">API Key 仅提交到本机后端，加密保存，不回显。请使用 OpenAI API 密钥；模型 ID 可根据账号权限修改。连接测试会产生少量 API 用量。</div><div id="modelList"></div><div class="card"><h2 id="modelFormTitle">添加模型</h2><form id="modelForm"><label>显示名称<input id="modelName" maxlength="80" required placeholder="ChatGPT"></label><div class="two"><label>接口类型<select id="apiKind"><option value="responses">OpenAI Responses</option><option value="chat_completions">OpenAI 兼容 Chat Completions</option></select></label><label>模型 ID<input id="modelCode" maxlength="200" required placeholder="gpt-5-mini"></label></div><label>API Base URL<input id="modelUrl" required placeholder="https://api.openai.com/v1" maxlength="500"></label><label>API Key<input id="apiKey" type="password" autocomplete="new-password" maxlength="1000" placeholder="编辑时留空保留已存密钥"></label><div class="two"><label>最大输出 Token<input id="maxTokens" type="number" min="500" max="16000" value="6000" required></label><div class="checks"><label><input type="checkbox" id="modelEnabled" checked> 启用模型</label><label><input type="checkbox" id="clearKey"> 清除已存密钥</label></div></div><div class="row"><button id="cancelModel" type="button">取消编辑 / 清空</button><button class="primary" type="submit">保存模型设置</button></div></form></div></section>
</main><aside id="chat" class="chat hidden" aria-label="项目追问"><div class="row"><h2>项目追问</h2><button id="closeChat" aria-label="关闭追问">×</button></div><p id="chatContext"></p><label>回答模型<select id="chatModel"></select></label><small id="chatReport"></small><button id="clearReport" class="text-button hidden">改为基于当前资料追问</button><div id="messages" aria-live="polite"></div><form id="chatForm"><textarea id="question" maxlength="3000" placeholder="例如：哪些问题需要优先尽调？" required></textarea><button id="askButton" class="primary" type="submit">发送追问</button></form><small>回答会发送当前项目资料和最近对话到所选 API。</small></aside><button id="toggleChat" class="chat-toggle primary">↗ 随时追问</button><footer>VC Intelligence · 本地投资研究工作台 · AI 推断需人工复核</footer></body></html>
````

*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:#f5f7fa;color:#17263c;font:15px/1.65 "Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif}header{background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #e4e9f0;padding:18px 6%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:40px;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5}.brand{text-decoration:none;color:inherit;font-weight:750;font-size:21px;letter-spacing:-.6px}.brand span{color:#4669e8}nav{display:flex;gap:8px}button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:0;border-radius:9px;padding:10px 20px;background:#edf1f8;color:#35455f}button:hover{filter:brightness(.97)}button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #93acf8;outline-offset:3px}button:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:wait}nav button{background:transparent}.active{background:#eaf0ff;color:#3458d6}.settings-nav{margin-left:auto;background:transparent}main{max-width:1080px;margin:46px auto;padding:0 25px}.eyebrow{color:#657ba6;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px}h1{font-size:34px;letter-spacing:-1px;margin:8px 0}h2{font-size:20px;margin:8px 0 16px}h3{font-size:16px;margin-top:24px}.subtitle,p{color:#718096}.steps{display:flex;gap:30px;margin:28px 0;color:#6e7f9a;font-size:13px}.card{background:#fff;border:1px solid ## launcher.py

````
"""Local one-click launcher for VC Intelligence Platform M01 (Windows)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
import webbrowser
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PYTHON = ROOT / '.venv' / 'Scripts' / 'python.exe'
BACKEND = 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/health'
FRONTEND = 'http://127.0.0.1:8501'
LOGS = ROOT / 'data' / 'logs'


def get(url: str, timeout: float = 1.5) -> tuple[int, str] | None:
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=timeout) as resp:
            return resp.status, resp.read(4096).decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
    except (OSError, urllib.error.URLError):
        return None


def main() -> int:
    if not PYTHON.is_file():
        print('ERROR: Missing .venv\\Scripts\\python.exe')
        print('Run: py -3.11 -m venv .venv')
        return 1
    if not (ROOT / 'backend' / 'main.py').exists() or not (ROOT / 'frontend' / 'app.py').exists():
        print('ERROR: Run this file from the M01 project root. Missing backend/main.py or frontend/app.py.')
        return 1
    LOGS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    processes = []
    handles = []
    try:
        backend = get(BACKEND)
        if backend and 'vc-platform-backend' in backend[1] and '"status":"ok"' in backend[1].replace(' ', ''):
            print('[OK] Backend already running on port 8000.')
        elif backend:
            print('[ERROR] Port 8000 is used by a different service. Stop it before using this launcher.')
            return 1
        else:
            handle = (LOGS / 'backend.log').open('a', encoding='utf-8')
            handles.append(handle)
            proc = subprocess.Popen([str(PYTHON), '-m', 'uvicorn', 'backend.main:app', '--host', '127.0.0.1', '--port', '8000'], cwd=ROOT, stdout=handle, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
            processes.append(proc)
            print('[START] Backend...')
        for _ in range(35):
            result = get(BACKEND)
            if result and 'vc-platform-backend' in result[1]:
                break
            if processes and processes[-1].poll() is not None:
                break
            time.sleep(.4)
        else:
            print('[ERROR] Backend did not become ready. See data\\logs\\backend.log')
            return 1
        if not get(BACKEND):
            print('[ERROR] Backend failed. See data\\logs\\backend.log')
            return 1

        if get(FRONTEND):
            print('[OK] Frontend already running on port 8501.')
        else:
            handle = (LOGS / 'frontend.log').open('a', encoding='utf-8')
            handles.append(handle)
            proc = subprocess.Popen([str(PYTHON), '-m', 'streamlit', 'run', 'frontend/app.py', '--server.address', '127.0.0.1', '--server.port', '8501', '--server.headless', 'true'], cwd=ROOT, stdout=handle, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
            processes.append(proc)
            print('[START] Frontend...')
        for _ in range(50):
            if get(FRONTEND):
                break
            if processes and processes[-1].poll() is not None:
                break
            time.sleep(.4)
        else:
            print('[ERROR] Frontend did not become ready. See data\\logs\\frontend.log')
            return 1
        if not get(FRONTEND):
            print('[ERROR] Frontend failed. See data\\logs\\frontend.log')
            return 1

        print('\n[READY] VC Intelligence Platform')
        print('Open only this page: ' + FRONTEND)
        print('Backend health (for troubleshooting): ' + BACKEND)
        print('Keep this window open; press Ctrl+C to stop services started here.')
        webbrowser.open(FRONTEND)
        while True:
            for proc in processes:
                if proc.poll() is not None:
                    print('[ERROR] A service exited. Check data\\logs\\*.log')
                    return 1
            time.sleep(1)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print('\nStopping services started by this launcher...')
        return 0
    finally:
        for proc in processes:
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:
                    proc.wait(timeout=5)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    proc.kill()
        for handle in handles:
            handle.close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
````

## launcher_web.py

````
"""Launch the new single-origin local UI; never reuse an unrelated listening service."""
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
import json
import webbrowser
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
URL='http://127.0.0.1:8503'


def main():
    python=next((p for p in [ROOT/'.venv314/Scripts/python.exe',ROOT/'.venv/Scripts/python.exe',ROOT/'.venv/bin/python'] if p.exists()),Path(sys.executable))
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(URL+'/health',timeout=1) as r:
            data=json.load(r)
        if data.get('service')=='vc-platform-backend':
            with urllib.request.urlopen(URL+'/api/v2/models',timeout=2):
                webbrowser.open(URL+'/app/')
                return
        raise RuntimeError('Port 8503 is already in use by another application.')
    except urllib.error.URLError:
        pass
    logs=ROOT/'data'/'logs';logs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with (logs/'web.log').open('a',encoding='utf-8') as log:
        proc=subprocess.Popen([str(python),'-m','uvicorn','backend.main:app','--host','127.0.0.1','--port','8503'],cwd=ROOT,stdout=log,stderr=log)
        try:
            for _ in range(60):
                if proc.poll() is not None:
                    raise RuntimeError('Startup failed. See data/logs/web.log')
                try:
                    with urllib.request.urlopen(URL+'/health',timeout=1):
                        break
                except OSError:
                    time.sleep(.5)
            else:
                raise RuntimeError('Startup timed out. See data/logs/web.log')
            webbrowser.open(URL+'/app/')
            print('VC Intelligence: '+URL+'/app/ (Ctrl+C to stop)')
            proc.wait()
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            pass
        finally:
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=5)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill()


if __name__=='__main__':
    main()
````

## README.md

````
# 新版使用入口（2026-11-09）

日常请使用 `start_web.bat`，打开 http://127.0.0.1:8503/app/ 。新界面为「创建分析 / 报告库 / 模型设置」，保留全部旧资料。下方M04D说明仅供旧版兼容参考。

1. 在项目目录创建Python虚拟环境，运行 `python -m pip install -r requirements.txt`。
2. 双击 `start_web.bat`，或运行 `python launcher_web.py`。
3. 进入模型设置，编辑唯一默认的ChatGPT，填写OpenAI API Key，保存后测试连接。默认模型ID为 `gpt-5-mini`，可按账号权限修改。
4. 上传BP，确认自动建议名称，选择模型并生成报告。报告可下载PDF，右下角可持续追问。

密钥加密保存在本机数据库，主密钥位于 `data/secrets/master.key`；备份时保留整个data目录，切勿提交Git。此应用仅限本机loopback使用，没有登录/多用户权限。输入仅在明确发起分析、追问或连接测试时发送至配置的服务商。

新版需求与重建规格：`docs/项目需求与重建规格.md`。实施计划：`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-09-upload-analysis.md`。新版本支持真实API，旧M04D接口继续保留Mock流程。

开发验证：安装 `requirements-dev.txt` 后运行 `python -m pytest -q`。测试使用临时数据库，不触碰业务数据；外部网络由替身隔离。浏览器验收脚本 `tests/browser_smoke.cjs` 使用Playwright，启动 `tests/browser_fixture.py` 后运行；该测试服务仅限8504隔离验收，不用于日常研究。

OpenAI接口实现依据：[Text generation](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/text)、[Structured model outputs](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/structured-outputs)、[GPT-5 mini](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5-mini)。当前输出使用提示词JSON和本地结构校验，不要求其他服务商支持strict schema。

---

# VC Intelligence Platform

面向一级市场项目研究的 AI 投资分析平台。以 VC 业务作为首个应用，逐步连接 BP 文档、结构化项目档案、证据引用、分析工作流和报告。初期运行在 Windows 本地，后续扩展公司内部应用。

本仓库整理自 2026 年 11 月 6 日提供的项目代码，包含 M04D 模拟分析工作流。

## 当前能力

| 功能 | 当前状态 |
| --- | --- |
| 项目创建与列表 | 已实现，使用 SQLite 持久化 |
| BP 上传 | 支持 PDF、PPTX、DOCX、XLSX，单文件最大 25 MB |
| 文本与部分表格解析 | 已实现，保留页码、段落、幻灯片、工作表等来源位置 |
| 项目速览 | 7 类、29 个字段，支持按需展开证据 |
| 事实维护 | 人工录入、审核、驳回与不同值提示，作为可选校正入口 |
| 分析任务 | 后台执行 Mock 流程，保存任务状态、输入快照与报告 |
| 报告页面 | 查看已保存报告与证据，下载 JSON |
| 模型调用底座 | 提供 Mock 与 OpenAI 兼容接口适配器，演示智能体可调用 |
| BP 自动语义提取、AI 审核与正式投资评分 | 待实现，目前分析任务固定为 Mock |
| OCR、外部事实核验、知识库、偏好记忆、多模型对比 | 后续开发 |

Mock 表示模拟实现。当前分析流程使用固定规则和模板组织资料、已有事实与追问，自动提取替身返回空结果。已有事实和引用来自项目资料，评分字段留空。配置真实模型后，仍需要继续开发 BP 提取与分析模块，才能获得真实 AI 报告。

用户目标流程为上传 BP 后由 AI 自动整理和检查，人工按需核对。现有 Mock 任务可以直接对已解析的 BP 运行，人工录入与审核是可选步骤。

## 技术与目录

推荐 Python 3.11，原项目在 Windows / Python 3.11.9 环境使用。

- `backend/` 包含 FastAPI 接口、SQLAlchemy 模型、文档解析和后台任务。
- `frontend/` 包含 Streamlit 界面。
- `core/` 包含模型适配器、提取与证据接口、字段字典和工作流。
- `applications/vc_investment/` 预留业务应用扩展位置。
- `tests/` 包含本次上传项目中已有的 M02、M03、M04A 测试。
- `launcher.py` 负责 Windows 本地一键启动。
- `start_platform.bat` 是日常启动入口。
- `start_backend.bat` 与 `start_frontend.bat` 用于分别启动服务。
- `requirements.txt` 定义运行依赖。
- `.env.example` 是密钥留空的本地配置模板。
- `.gitignore` 定义环境、业务数据、缓存与备份等排除规则。

## 首次上传到已创建的 GitHub 仓库

推荐使用 GitHub Desktop，团队后续可以在同一流程中查看差异、提交、推送与合并。

1. 安装 GitHub Desktop 并登录有仓库权限的账号。
2. 打开 `File → Clone repository`，选择已创建的 `VC_Intelligence_Platform` 仓库。
3. 将 Local Path 设置为一个新的空目录，例如 `D:\VC_Intelligence_Platform_Team`，点击 Clone。
4. 解压整理后的代码包，将包内 `VC_Intelligence_Platform` 文件夹中的全部内容复制到刚刚克隆的目录。`backend`、`frontend`、`README.md` 应直接位于仓库根目录，避免再嵌套一层项目文件夹。
5. 用包内的 `README.md` 和 `.gitignore` 替换仓库创建时生成的同名文件。保留克隆时产生的 `.git` 目录。
6. 在 GitHub Desktop 的 Changes 中检查文件列表，确认环境配置、业务数据与备份均未列入提交。`.env.example` 应当在提交列表中，API Key 应为空。
7. 填写提交说明，例如“首次导入 M04D 项目代码和中文说明”，点击 `Commit to main`，再点击 `Push origin`。
8. 在 GitHub 网页确认仓库根目录显示源码与本 README，然后将仓库链接放进项目组文档。

网页上传也可用于首次导入。在当前仓库的 `Add file → Upload files` 中上传代码包解压后的内部文件与文件夹，确认预览保留正确目录结构。对已存在的 `README.md`、`.gitignore`，可以点击文件的编辑按钮，替换为本包内容后提交。网页上传时需自行确认选中的内容，不能依靠本地 `.gitignore` 自动过滤拖入的文件。

后续持续开发推荐使用 Desktop 克隆目录。ZIP 用于交付，仓库中保留展开后的文件。

## 新同事首次运行

克隆仓库后，每位同事在自己的电脑创建 Python 环境。下面以 `D:\VC_Intelligence_Platform_Team` 为例，命令在 CMD 中逐行执行。

```bat
cd /d D:\VC_Intelligence_Platform_Team
py -3.11 -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt
copy .env.example .env
start_platform.bat
```

默认配置为 Mock，可以直接运行基础流程。若 `.env` 已存在，保留自己的配置。

| 地址或路径 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `http://127.0.0.1:8501` | 日常使用网页 |
| `http://127.0.0.1:8000/health` | 后端健康检查 |
| `http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs` | 接口文档 |
| `data/database/vc_intelligence.db` | 本机数据库，运行时自动创建 |
| `data/uploads/` | 本机上传文件 |
| `data/logs/` | 启动与服务日志 |

日常双击当前仓库目录的 `start_platform.bat`。关闭时在启动窗口按 `Ctrl+C`。若原目录已有服务在运行，先停止旧窗口，以便新代码生效。

## 原开发者如何迁移到仓库目录

建议将克隆目录作为后续唯一的开发与运行目录，避免同时修改两套代码。

1. 停止旧目录 `D:\VC_Intelligence_Platform` 的前后端服务。
2. 按“新同事首次运行”在新仓库目录创建 `.venv` 并安装依赖。
3. 如要继续原来的项目记录，将旧目录的 `data` 整个文件夹复制到新仓库目录。服务完全停止后再复制，以保持数据库与上传文件一致。
4. 如要沿用原配置，将旧目录 `.env` 复制到新仓库目录。
5. 查看 GitHub Desktop 的 Changes，确认 `data` 与 `.env` 均被忽略。
6. 从新仓库目录启动并确认项目、文件和报告正常。此后所有代码修改和后续更新包都应用到这个目录。

虚拟环境请在新目录重新创建。原来的项目目录可作为迁移备份，确认新目录正常后再自行安排归档。

## 后续修改、覆盖与上传

### 自己修改代码

1. 打开 GitHub Desktop，确认当前仓库与分支。
2. 在开始改动前，保持工作区干净，点击 `Fetch origin`，有更新时点击 `Pull origin`。
3. 团队共同开发时，从最新 `main` 新建功能分支，例如 `feature/llm-extraction`。
4. 直接编辑本地仓库目录内的文件。
5. 运行平台验证相关功能，回到 Changes 检查差异。
6. 填写说明并 Commit，再 Push。首次推送新分支时按钮可能显示 `Publish branch`。
7. 创建 Pull Request，请另一位成员检查后合入 `main`。

`Commit` 将版本保存在本机，`Push` 将提交发送到 GitHub，`Pull` 将远端提交同步到本机。

### 收到别人或 AI 提供的更新文件

先提交或暂存自己尚未完成的改动，再同步远端，并在功能分支中应用更新。

- 只将明确说明需要修改的文件放到仓库对应相对路径。若更新内容为 `frontend/app.py`，目标就是仓库中的 `frontend/app.py`。
- 若更新包有安装器，将目标指向当前仓库目录。
- 在 Changes 中检查实际差异，尤其是同事也修改过的文件。整文件替换可能覆盖同事的新逻辑，应逐项合并后再测试提交。
- 后续接口变更需同时检查前后端和依赖。
- 合并请求中写明修改目的、验证方式与结果，便于团队审阅。

Git 会记录增删改，后续每次提交可以只包含相关文件。删除文件应在仓库内执行并提交删除记录。

### 同步同事的修改

工作区干净时执行 Fetch 和 Pull。若自己有未提交改动，先 Commit 或使用 Desktop 暂存功能。遇到冲突时，打开冲突文件，结合双方修改决定最终内容，确认后完成合并。

多人协作以功能分支和 Pull Request 为主。主分支保存可运行基线，验证通过的里程碑可打标签。

## 上传内容与排除内容

本次整理包保留当前运行源码、启动脚本、依赖和已有测试，新增本 README 与完善的忽略规则，并重新生成了密钥为空的配置模板。

| 类别 | 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| `applications/`、`backend/`、`core/`、`frontend/`、`tests/` | 上传源码 |
| `launcher.py`、启动脚本、`requirements.txt` | 上传 |
| `README.md`、`.gitignore`、`.env.example` | 上传 |
| `.env` | 在每台电脑本地保留 |
| `.venv/`、缓存目录 | 每位开发者自行创建 |
| `data/` 中的 BP、数据库和日志 | 在本机或有权限的业务资料系统管理 |
| `code_backups/`、旧升级 ZIP、备份版前端 | 排除 |
| 历史安装脚本、旧版 README、仅描述 M01 的架构说明 | 本次整理包已省略，当前说明汇总于本 README |

`.gitignore` 对尚未跟踪的文件生效。如果某个文件已经提交到 Git，后续添加忽略规则还需要另行取消跟踪。正式提交前查看 Changes 或 `git status`。

## 基础验收与开发测试

首次启动可依次检查项目创建、BP 上传与解析、速览与证据、事实维护、模拟分析、报告重开和重启后的持久化。

本次上传源码包含三个测试文件，对应五个已有测试用例。此前升级包中的新增测试文件未出现在本次上传的项目目录，因此仓库说明按实际收到的文件记录。

已有接口测试会在默认 `data` 目录写入测试项目、文件和记录。请在独立的临时克隆副本内执行，使用空白测试数据目录。开发测试依赖可另行安装。

```bat
.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install pytest httpx reportlab
.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q
```

后续团队开发应补齐 M04D 回归测试，并将测试数据库与业务数据库隔离。

## 后续开发目标

- 接入一个真实测试模型，完成 BP 自动提取、引用校验与 AI 检查。
- 固定评测材料、Prompt 和输出结构，对比不同模型的报告质量与成本。
- 生成适合投资负责人阅读的简洁诊断书，支持按需展开证据。
- 完善风险评分、尽调追问、OCR 与外部核验。
- 增加对话问答、项目记忆、后台偏好积累与专业智能体协作。
- 随公司业务推进权限管理、数据隔离、日志审计和服务器部署。

import os,sys,json,tempfile

sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
os.environ['VC_DATA_DIR']=str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'data'/'browser-qa')

def fixture_generate(config,messages):
    if messages[0]['role']=='user':
        return {'text':'OK','usage':{'total_tokens':2}}
    context=json.loads(messages[-1]['content'])
    sid=context['sources'][0]['id']
    result=({'answer':'测试回答：产品来自企业资料，尚未核验。','source_ids':[sid]} if context['question'] else

             'sections':[{'title':'项目概况','body':'企业资料披露其核心产品为工业机器人。需要核验订单和客户信息。','source_ids':[sid]},

from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from io import BytesIO
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from docx import Document
from pptx import Presentation
from openpyxl import Workbook
from backend.document_parser import extract
from backend.main import app


def make_files(root):
    doc = Document(); doc.add_paragraph('Revenue 2025: 100'); doc.save(root/'sample.docx')
    prs = Presentation(); slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5]); slide.shapes.title.text = 'Company overview'; prs.save(root/'sample.pptx')
    wb=Workbook(); wb.active['A1']='Revenue'; wb.active['B1']=100; wb.save(root/'sample.xlsx')
    from reportlab.pdfgen.canvas import Canvas
    c=Canvas(str(root/'sample.pdf')); c.drawString(50,750,'Revenue 2025: 100'); c.save()


def test_formats_and_locations():
    with TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        root=Path(tmp);make_files(root)
        for suffix, location in [('.docx','段落'),('.pptx','幻灯片'),('.xlsx','工作表'),('.pdf','第1页')]:
            p=root/('sample'+suffix)
            segs,_=extract(p)
            assert segs and any(location in s.location for s in segs)


def test_api_preserves_project_and_upload():
    client=TestClient(app)
    with client:
        project = client.post('/api/projects',json={'name':'M03 test', 'description':''}).json()
        bio=BytesIO()
        d=Document(); d.add_paragraph('M03 example claim'); d.save(bio)
        result=client.post(f"/api/projects/{project['id']}/documents", files={'file':('case.docx',bio.getvalue(),'application/octet-stream')})
        assert result.status_code==201, result.text
        info=result.json(); assert info['status']=='processed'
        listed=client.get(f"/api/projects/{project['id']}/documents").json()
        assert any(x['id']==info['id'] for x in listed)
        segments=client.get(f"/api/documents/{info['id']}/segments").json()['items']
        assert any('M03 example claim' in x['content'] for x in segments)
        assert client.post(f"/api/projects/{project['id']}/documents", files={'file':('bad.exe',b'evil')}).status_code==400
````

````
"""Tests run against a disposable assembled project directory, never user's db."""
from io import BytesIO
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app
from docx import Document


def test_m04a_grounding_and_profile():
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        p=client.post('/api/projects',json={'name':'M04A demo','description':''})
        assert p.status_code==201,p.text
        pid=p.json()['id']
        b=BytesIO();d=Document();d.add_paragraph('本轮计划融资5000万元，2025年营收2800万元。');d.save(b)
        res=client.post(f'/api/projects/{pid}/documents',files={'file':('demo.docx',b.getvalue(),'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document')})
        assert res.status_code==201,res.text
        docid=res.json()['id']
        segments=client.get(f'/api/documents/{docid}/segments').json()['items']
        sid=next(s['id'] for s in segments if '融资' in s['content'])
        base={'segment_id':sid,'field_key':'financing_amount','value_text':'5000万元','evidence_quote':'本轮计划融资5000万元'}
        assert client.post(f'/api/projects/{pid}/facts',json={**base,'evidence_quote':'不存在的引文'}).status_code==422
        fact=client.post(f'/api/projects/{pid}/facts',json=base)
        assert fact.status_code==201,fact.text
        fid=fact.json()['id']
        assert fact.json()['verification_status']=='unverified'
        assert client.get(f'/api/projects/{pid}/structured-profile').json()['fields']=={}
        approve=client.patch(f'/api/facts/{fid}/review',json={'review_status':'confirmed','reviewer_note':'原文一致'})
        assert approve.status_code==200,approve.text
        profile=client.get(f'/api/projects/{pid}/structured-profile').json()
        assert profile['fields']['financing_amount'][0]['value']=='5000万元'
        assert profile['fields']['financing_amount'][0]['verification_status']=='unverified'
        assert 'revenue' in profile['missing_fields']
        another=client.post(f'/api/projects/{pid}/facts',json={**base,'value_text':'6000万元'})
        fid2=another.json()['id']
        client.patch(f'/api/facts/{fid2}/review',json={'review_status':'confirmed'})
        profile=client.get(f'/api/projects/{pid}/structured-profile').json()
        assert profile['potential_conflicts'][0]['field_key']=='financing_amount'
        preview=client.post(f'/api/projects/{pid}/extraction/preview').json()
        assert preview['mode']=='mock' and preview['candidates']==[]

## tests/test_providers.py

````
import json
import urllib.error
from contextlib import contextmanager
import pytest
from backend import providers


def cfg(kind='responses'):
    return {'secret':providers.encrypt('local-test-key'),'model':'example-model','base_url':'https://api.openai.com/v1',
            'api_kind':kind,'max_output_tokens':2000}


def transport(monkeypatch,result,check=None):
    class Response:
        def __enter__(self):return self
        def __exit__(self,*args):pass
        def read(self,n):return json.dumps(result).encode()
    class Opener:
        def open(self,req,timeout):
            if check:check(req,timeout)
            return Response()
    monkeypatch.setattr(providers.urllib.request,'build_opener',lambda *args:Opener())


def test_responses_request_and_output(monkeypatch):
    def check(req,timeout):
        body=json.loads(req.data)
        assert req.full_url=='https://api.openai.com/v1/responses'
        assert body['store'] is False and body['max_output_tokens']==2000
        assert body['input'][0]['content']=='hello'
        assert 'api_key' not in body and timeout==120
    transport(monkeypatch,{'status':'completed','output':[{'type':'reasoning'},{'type':'message','content':[{'type':'output_text','text':'answer'}]}],'usage':{'total_tokens':9}},check)
    assert providers.generate(cfg(),[{'role':'user','content':'hello'}])=={'text':'answer','usage':{'total_tokens':9}}


def test_incomplete_output_never_becomes_report(monkeypatch):
    transport(monkeypatch,{'status':'incomplete','output':[]})
    with pytest.raises(providers.ProviderError,match='未完整'):
        providers.generate(cfg(),[])


def test_chat_compatible_request(monkeypatch):
    def check(req,timeout):
        body=json.loads(req.data)
        assert req.full_url.endswith('/chat/completions')
        assert body['messages'][0]['content']=='hello' and body['max_tokens']==2000
    transport(monkeypatch,{'choices':[{'finish_reason':'stop','message':{'role':'assistant','content':'ok'}}],'usage':{}},check)
    assert providers.generate(cfg('chat_completions'),[{'role':'user','content':'hello'}])['text']=='ok'


def test_http_error_does_not_leak_server_body(monkeypatch):
    class Opener:
        def open(self,*a,**kw):
            raise urllib.error.HTTPError('https://secret-url',401,'secret-response',{},None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(providers.urllib.request,'build_opener',lambda *args:Opener())
    with pytest.raises(providers.ProviderError) as exc:providers.generate(cfg(),[])
    assert '401' in str(exc.value) and 'secret' not in str(exc.value)


def test_redirect_credentials_not_forwarded():
    assert providers.NoRedirect().redirect_request(None,None,302,'',{},'https://attacker.example') is None
````

## tests/test_workspace.py

````
import json
import uuid
import time
import threading
from io import BytesIO
from docx import Document
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app
from functools import lru_cache


@lru_cache
def doc_bytes(text):
    buf = BytesIO()
    d = Document()
    for line in text.splitlines():
        d.add_paragraph(line)
    d.save(buf)
    return buf.getvalue()


def import_bp(client, text='企业名称：星河机器人\n核心产品为工业机器人。', request_id=None):
    return client.post('/api/v2/imports', data={'request_id': request_id or str(uuid.uuid4())},
                       files={'file': ('company.docx', doc_bytes(text))})


def test_default_model_and_secret_updates():
    with TestClient(app) as c:
        response = c.get('/api/v2/models')
        assert response.status_code == 200
        models = response.json()
        assert len(models) == 1 and models[0]['name'] == 'ChatGPT'
        m = models[0]
        result = c.put(f"/api/v2/models/{m['id']}", json={**m, 'api_key': 'test-secret-123'})
        assert result.status_code == 200, result.text
        assert result.json()['key_configured']
        assert 'test-secret' not in result.text
        # Editing a URL must not silently forward a saved key to a new endpoint.
        moved = c.put(f"/api/v2/models/{m['id']}", json={**m, 'base_url': 'https://other.example/v1'})
        assert moved.status_code == 422
        whitespace = c.put(f"/api/v2/models/{m['id']}", json={**m, 'base_url':'https://other.example/v1','api_key':' '})
        assert whitespace.status_code == 422
        from backend.database import DB_PATH
        assert b'test-secret-123' not in DB_PATH.read_bytes()


def test_connection_test_is_explicit_and_sanitized(monkeypatch):
    from backend import providers
    monkeypatch.setattr(providers,'generate',lambda cfg,msg:{'text':'ok','usage':{'total_tokens':1}})
    with TestClient(app) as c:
        model=configure(c)
        r=c.post(f"/api/v2/models/{model['id']}/test")
        assert r.status_code==200,r.text
        assert r.json()['ok'] is True and 'secret' not in r.text


def test_frontend_served_and_invalid_host_rejected():
    with TestClient(app) as c:
        assert c.get('/app/').status_code==200
        assert c.get('/app/app.js').status_code==200
        assert c.get('/api/v2/models',headers={'Host':'attacker.example'}).status_code==400


def test_import_auto_name_reuse_and_rename():
    with TestClient(app) as c:
        rid = str(uuid.uuid4())
        r = import_bp(c, request_id=rid)
        assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
        p = r.json()['project']
        assert p['name'] == '星河机器人'
        reused = import_bp(c, request_id=rid)
        assert reused.status_code == 201 and reused.json()['project']['id'] == p['id']
        conflict = import_bp(c, text='不同资料', request_id=rid)
        assert conflict.status_code == 409
        assert c.patch(f"/api/v2/projects/{p['id']}", json={'name':'  新名称  '}).json()['name']=='新名称'
        assert c.patch(f"/api/v2/projects/{p['id']}", json={'name':'  '}).status_code == 422
        assert any(x['id']==p['id'] for x in c.get('/api/v2/projects').json())


def test_invalid_import_does_not_create_project():
    with TestClient(app) as c:
        before = len(c.get('/api/projects').json())
        r=c.post('/api/v2/imports',data={'request_id':str(uuid.uuid4())},files={'file':('bad.exe',b'bad')})
        assert r.status_code==400
        assert len(c.get('/api/projects').json())==before


def test_missing_key_and_cross_project_report_are_rejected():
    with TestClient(app) as c:
        r=import_bp(c)
        assert r.status_code==201
        pid=r.json()['project']['id']
        model=c.post('/api/v2/models',json={'name':'No key', 'model':'gpt-5-mini', 'base_url':'https://api.openai.com/v1', 'api_kind':'responses'}).json()
        r=c.post(f'/api/v2/projects/{pid}/runs',json={'model_ids':[model['id']], 'request_id':str(uuid.uuid4())})
        assert r.status_code==422 and '密钥' in r.text
        r=c.post(f'/api/v2/projects/{pid}/messages',json={'model_id':model['id'],'question':'test','report_id':999999,'request_id':str(uuid.uuid4())})
        assert r.status_code==404


def test_api_rejects_cross_origin_mutation():
    with TestClient(app) as c:
        r=c.post('/api/projects',json={'name':'unwanted'},headers={'Origin':'https://evil.example'})
        assert r.status_code==403


def configure(c, name='ChatGPT'):
    models=c.get('/api/v2/models').json()
    m=next((x for x in models if x['name']==name),None)
    payload={'name':name,'model':'gpt-5-mini','base_url':'https://api.openai.com/v1','api_kind':'responses','api_key':'test-only-key'}
    return (c.put(f"/api/v2/models/{m['id']}",json=payload) if m else c.post('/api/v2/models',json=payload)).json()


def wait_job(c,job_id):
    for _ in range(100):
        r=c.get(f'/api/v2/jobs/{job_id}')
        assert r.status_code==200, r.text
        j=r.json()
        if j['status'] in ('completed','failed'):
            return j
        time.sleep(.03)
    raise AssertionError('job did not finish')


def fake_report(config,messages):
    context=json.loads(messages[-1]['content'])
    source=context['sources'][0]['id']
    return {'text':json.dumps({'summary':'企业自述为机器人企业，尚未核验。','sections':[{'title':'项目概况','body':'工业机器人。','source_ids':[source]}],'questions':['请提供订单依据。']},ensure_ascii=False),'usage':{'total_tokens':100}}


def test_parallel_reports_snapshot_pdf_and_chat(monkeypatch):
    from backend import providers
    barrier=threading.Barrier(2)
    def parallel(config,messages):
        barrier.wait(timeout=5)
        return fake_report(config,messages)
    monkeypatch.setattr(providers,'generate',parallel)
    with TestClient(app) as c:
        pid=import_bp(c).json()['project']['id']
        a,b=configure(c),configure(c,'Second')
        payload={'model_ids':[a['id'],b['id']], 'request_id':str(uuid.uuid4())}
        r=c.post(f'/api/v2/projects/{pid}/runs',json=payload)
        assert r.status_code==202,r.text
        ids=[j['id'] for j in r.json()]
        jobs=[wait_job(c,x) for x in ids]
        assert all(j['status']=='completed' for j in jobs),jobs
        repeat=c.post(f'/api/v2/projects/{pid}/runs',json=payload)
        assert [j['id'] for j in repeat.json()]==ids
        assert all('secret' not in json.dumps(j) for j in jobs)
        c.patch(f'/api/v2/projects/{pid}',json={'name':'已修改项目名'})
        assert c.get(f'/api/v2/jobs/{ids[0]}').json()['project_name']=='星河机器人'
        pdf=c.get(f'/api/v2/reports/{ids[0]}/pdf')
        assert pdf.status_code==200 and pdf.content.startswith(b'%PDF-')
        from pypdf import PdfReader
        text=''.join(p.extract_text() for p in PdfReader(BytesIO(pdf.content)).pages)
        assert '星河机器人' in text and '工业机器人' in text and 'company.docx' in text
        def answer(config,messages):
            context=json.loads(messages[-1]['content'])
            assert context['report']['summary'].startswith('企业自述')
            assert context['question']=='核心产品？'
            return {'text':json.dumps({'answer':'工业机器人，来自企业自述。','source_ids':[context['sources'][0]['id']]}),'usage':{}}
        monkeypatch.setattr(providers,'generate',answer)
        q={'model_id':a['id'],'report_id':ids[0],'question':'核心产品？','request_id':str(uuid.uuid4())}
        res=c.post(f'/api/v2/projects/{pid}/messages',json=q)
        assert res.status_code==202,res.text
        message=wait_job(c,res.json()['id'])
        assert message['status']=='completed' and message['result']['answer'].startswith('工业机器人')
        assert len(c.get(f'/api/v2/projects/{pid}/messages').json())==1
        other=import_bp(c,text='公司名称：另一个项目').json()['project']['id']
        assert c.post(f'/api/v2/projects/{other}/messages',json=q).status_code==404
        assert c.get(f'/api/v2/projects/{other}/messages').json()==[]


def test_provider_failure_and_invalid_citation_not_completed(monkeypatch):
    from backend import providers
    def invalid(config,messages):
        if config['name']=='Broken':
            raise providers.ProviderError('API 密钥无效（HTTP 401）。')
        return {'text':json.dumps({'summary':'x','sections':[{'title':'x','body':'x','source_ids':[999999]}],'questions':[]}), 'usage':{}}
    monkeypatch.setattr(providers,'generate',invalid)
    with TestClient(app) as c:
        pid=import_bp(c).json()['project']['id']
        a,b=configure(c),configure(c,'Broken')
        r=c.post(f'/api/v2/projects/{pid}/runs',json={'model_ids':[a['id'],b['id']], 'request_id':str(uuid.uuid4())})
        assert r.status_code==202,r.text
        jobs=[wait_job(c,j['id']) for j in r.json()]
        assert all(j['status']=='failed' for j in jobs)
        assert '引用' in jobs[0]['error']
        assert '401' in jobs[1]['error']
        assert not any(j['id'] in [x['id'] for x in jobs] for j in c.get('/api/v2/reports').json() if not j.get('legacy'))


def test_corrected_facts_are_in_model_input_and_batch_identity_is_immutable(monkeypatch):
    from backend import providers
    def inspect(config,messages):
        context=json.loads(messages[-1]['content'])
        assert context['facts'][0]['value']=='已人工补充的产品'
        return fake_report(config,messages)
    monkeypatch.setattr(providers,'generate',inspect)
    with TestClient(app) as c:
        imported=import_bp(c).json();pid=imported['project']['id']
        segment=c.get(f"/api/documents/{imported['document']['id']}/segments").json()['items'][0]
        c.post(f'/api/projects/{pid}/facts',json={'segment_id':segment['id'],'field_key':'product','value_text':'已人工补充的产品','evidence_quote':segment['content']})
        a,b=configure(c),configure(c,'Other model')
        request_id=str(uuid.uuid4())
        r=c.post(f'/api/v2/projects/{pid}/runs',json={'model_ids':[a['id']], 'request_id':request_id})
        assert wait_job(c,r.json()[0]['id'])['status']=='completed'
        changed=c.post(f'/api/v2/projects/{pid}/runs',json={'model_ids':[b['id']], 'request_id':request_id})
        assert changed.status_code==409
